---
title: "Behavioral Statistical Analysis: E1 + E2 + Integrative (GLMM rejection, LMM logRT)"
subtitle: "Single-file three-stage pipeline. Stages E1 and E2 run independent two-stratum analyses (main + unfair-only). Stage Integrative pools E1 and E2 with Experiment as a between-subjects factor for a 3-way interaction model. Bates 5-step random-structure selection (Matuschek et al., 2017). APA reporting: 95% CI on all estimates, partial eta-squared for omnibus LMM tests, odds ratios for GLMM, percent RT change for LMM."
author: "Project Research Team"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: 
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    code_folding: show
    theme: flatly
    fig_width: 10
    fig_height: 6
