``` {r run-and-report-2way}
# ==============================================================================
# 5. Stage 1 Runner: 2-way analysis (E1 / E2 single-experiment).
# ==============================================================================
#
# Used for E1 and E2 stages. The 3-way Integrative variant is below in
# run_behavior_analysis_3way.
#
# This function:
#   1. Fits the Stage 1 model via Bates 5-step.
#   2. Runs Type III ANOVA with Satterthwaite -> KR -> Wald cascade (LMM)
#      or Wald only (GLMM).
#   3. Decomposes interactions if omnibus p < 0.05 (confirmatory) or
#      0.05 <= p < 0.10 (marginal -> Supplementary).
#   4. Reports main effects, post-hoc contrasts, descriptives, R-squared.
#   5. Writes REPRODUCIBILITY.txt, markdown tables, RDS model object, Excel.
run_behavior_analysis <- function(data, analysis_name, outcome_var, fixed_terms,
                                  include_terms, model_family, out_dir, exp_version,
                                  posthoc_factors = NULL,
                                  random_max_vars = c("emotion", "offer_type"),
                                  timeout_sec = 1800) {
  
  if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  
  progress_log(sprintf(">>> Analysis: %s [%s] (N_subj = %d, N_trial = %d)",
                       analysis_name, exp_version,
                       dplyr::n_distinct(data$participant_id_internal), nrow(data)))
  
  # ---- Fit Stage 1 model via Bates 5-step ----
  FINAL_MODEL <- fit_stage1_bates(data, outcome_var, fixed_terms,
                                  include_terms, model_family,
                                  random_max_vars = random_max_vars,
                                  group_name = "participant_id_internal",
                                  timeout_sec = timeout_sec)
  diag_log <- attr(FINAL_MODEL, "bates_diag")
  
  formula_str <- paste(deparse(formula(FINAL_MODEL)), collapse = " ")
  progress_log(sprintf("[Final model] %s", stringr::str_squish(formula_str)),
               indent = 1)
  
  # ---- Type III ANOVA ----
  progress_log("[ANOVA] Computing Type III tests...", indent = 1)
  t_anova <- Sys.time()
  
  if (model_family == "binomial") {
    anova_res <- car::Anova(FINAL_MODEL, type = 3, test.statistic = "Chisq")
    diag_log$anova_method <- "Wald_chi_square_GLMM"
  } else {
    if (inherits(FINAL_MODEL, "merMod") &&
        !inherits(FINAL_MODEL, "lmerModLmerTest")) {
      FINAL_MODEL_lt <- tryCatch(
        lmerTest::as_lmerModLmerTest(FINAL_MODEL),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      if (!is.null(FINAL_MODEL_lt)) FINAL_MODEL <- FINAL_MODEL_lt
    }
    
    anova_res <- NULL
    method_used <- NA_character_
    
    # Attempt 1: Satterthwaite.
    anova_res <- tryCatch({
      res <- suppressWarnings(anova(FINAL_MODEL, type = 3, ddf = "Satterthwaite"))
      if (any(grepl("^Pr", colnames(res)))) {
        method_used <- "Satterthwaite_F"
        res
      } else {
        progress_log("[ANOVA] Satterthwaite returned no p-value column; trying Kenward-Roger.",
                     indent = 2)
        NULL
      }
    }, error = function(e) {
      progress_log(sprintf("[ANOVA] Satterthwaite errored (%s); trying Kenward-Roger.",
                           conditionMessage(e)), indent = 2)
      NULL
    })
    
    # Attempt 2: Kenward-Roger.
    if (is.null(anova_res)) {
      anova_res <- tryCatch({
        res <- suppressWarnings(anova(FINAL_MODEL, type = 3, ddf = "Kenward-Roger"))
        if (any(grepl("^Pr", colnames(res)))) {
          method_used <- "Kenward_Roger_F"
          res
        } else {
          progress_log("[ANOVA] Kenward-Roger returned no p-value column; falling back to Wald.",
                       indent = 2)
          NULL
        }
      }, error = function(e) {
        progress_log(sprintf("[ANOVA] Kenward-Roger errored (%s); falling back to Wald.",
                             conditionMessage(e)), indent = 2)
        NULL
      })
    }
    
    # Attempt 3: Wald.
    if (is.null(anova_res)) {
      anova_res <- car::Anova(FINAL_MODEL, type = 3, test.statistic = "Chisq")
      method_used <- "Wald_chi_square"
    }
    
    diag_log$anova_method <- method_used
  }
  
  progress_log(sprintf("[ANOVA] Method: %s. Elapsed: %s.",
                       diag_log$anova_method, format_elapsed(t_anova)),
               indent = 2)
  
  anova_apa <- format_anova_apa(anova_res, FINAL_MODEL)
  print(anova_apa %>% dplyr::select(Effect, APA_Report, Sig))
  
  # ---- Post-hoc decomposition ----
  progress_log("[Post-hoc] Extracting marginal means and contrasts...", indent = 1)
  
  target_2way <- if ("emotion:offer_type" %in% rownames(anova_res)) {
    "emotion:offer_type"
  } else if ("emotion:reaction" %in% rownames(anova_res)) {
    "emotion:reaction"
  } else NA_character_
  
  p_int_2way <- NA_real_
  if (!is.na(target_2way) && target_2way %in% rownames(anova_res)) {
    for (pcol in c("Pr(>F)", "Pr(>Chisq)")) {
      if (pcol %in% colnames(anova_res)) {
        val <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(anova_res[target_2way, pcol]))
        if (length(val) == 1 && !is.na(val)) {
          p_int_2way <- val; break
        }
      }
    }
  }
  if (is.na(p_int_2way)) p_int_2way <- 1.0
  
  list_of_tables <- list(
    "ANOVA_Main" = anova_apa,
    "Model_Formula" = data.frame(Formula = formula_str),
    "Model_Coefficients" = format_coefs(FINAL_MODEL),
    "R2_NakagawaSchielzeth" = extract_r2_table(FINAL_MODEL, analysis_name)
  )
  
  if (is.null(posthoc_factors)) {
    if (analysis_name == "LMM_RT_unfair") {
      posthoc_factors <- list(within = "reaction", between = "emotion")
    } else {
      posthoc_factors <- list(within = "offer_type", between = "emotion")
    }
  }
  f_within <- posthoc_factors$within
  f_between <- posthoc_factors$between
  
  scale_hint <- dplyr::case_when(
    model_family == "binomial" ~ "logit",
    outcome_var == "logRT"     ~ "logRT",
    TRUE                        ~ "raw"
  )
  
  pairs_with_ci <- function(emm, adjust = "fdr") {
    pp <- pairs(emm, adjust = adjust)
    summary(pp, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))
  }
  
  posthoc_status <- dplyr::case_when(
    p_int_2way < confirmatory_alpha             ~ "Confirmatory",
    p_int_2way < marginal_threshold             ~ "Exploratory_Marginal",
    TRUE                                         ~ "Not_triggered"
  )
  
  list_of_supp_tables <- list()
  
  if (posthoc_status %in% c("Confirmatory", "Exploratory_Marginal")) {
    target_list <- if (posthoc_status == "Confirmatory") "list_of_tables" else "list_of_supp_tables"
    progress_log(sprintf("[Post-hoc] Interaction p = %.4f -> %s. Routing simple effects to %s.",
                         p_int_2way, posthoc_status,
                         ifelse(target_list == "list_of_tables", "main", "Supplementary")),
                 indent = 1)
    
    progress_log(sprintf("[Post-hoc 1/3] %s | %s (FDR)...", f_within, f_between),
                 indent = 2)
    t_ph <- Sys.time()
    f1 <- as.formula(sprintf("~ %s | %s", f_within, f_between))
    so_em <- format_posthoc_apa(
      pairs_with_ci(emmeans::emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, f1), adjust = "fdr"),
      scale_hint = scale_hint
    )
    progress_log(sprintf("[Post-hoc 1/3] done (%s).", format_elapsed(t_ph)), indent = 3)
    so_em$Status <- posthoc_status
    
    progress_log(sprintf("[Post-hoc 2/3] %s | %s (FDR)...", f_between, f_within),
                 indent = 2)
    t_ph <- Sys.time()
    f2 <- as.formula(sprintf("~ %s | %s", f_between, f_within))
    se_off <- format_posthoc_apa(
      pairs_with_ci(emmeans::emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, f2), adjust = "fdr"),
      scale_hint = scale_hint
    )
    progress_log(sprintf("[Post-hoc 2/3] done (%s).", format_elapsed(t_ph)), indent = 3)
    se_off$Status <- posthoc_status
    
    progress_log("[Post-hoc 3/3] interaction contrasts (FDR)...", indent = 2)
    t_ph <- Sys.time()
    f3 <- as.formula(sprintf("~ %s * %s", f_between, f_within))
    int_contr <- format_posthoc_apa(
      summary(contrast(emmeans::emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, f3),
                       interaction = "pairwise", adjust = "fdr"),
              infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)),
      scale_hint = scale_hint
    )
    progress_log(sprintf("[Post-hoc 3/3] done (%s).", format_elapsed(t_ph)), indent = 3)
    int_contr$Status <- posthoc_status
    
    if (posthoc_status == "Confirmatory") {
      list_of_tables[[sprintf("Simple_%s_by_%s", f_within, f_between)]] <- so_em
      list_of_tables[[sprintf("Simple_%s_by_%s", f_between, f_within)]] <- se_off
      list_of_tables[["Interaction_Contrasts"]] <- int_contr
    } else {
      list_of_supp_tables[[sprintf("MARGINAL_Simple_%s_by_%s", f_within, f_between)]] <- so_em
      list_of_supp_tables[[sprintf("MARGINAL_Simple_%s_by_%s", f_between, f_within)]] <- se_off
      list_of_supp_tables[["MARGINAL_Interaction_Contrasts"]] <- int_contr
    }
    
  } else {
    progress_log(sprintf("[Post-hoc] Interaction p = %.4f -> Reporting main effects only.",
                         p_int_2way), indent = 1)
  }
  
  # Always extract main effects.
  progress_log(sprintf("[Main effect] %s pairwise (FDR)...", f_between), indent = 2)
  t_me <- Sys.time()
  list_of_tables[[sprintf("Main_Effect_%s", f_between)]] <- format_posthoc_apa(
    pairs_with_ci(emmeans::emmeans(FINAL_MODEL,
                                   as.formula(sprintf("~ %s", f_between))),
                  adjust = "fdr"),
    scale_hint = scale_hint
  )
  progress_log(sprintf("[Main effect %s] done (%s).", f_between, format_elapsed(t_me)),
               indent = 3)
  
  progress_log(sprintf("[Main effect] %s pairwise (Tukey)...", f_within), indent = 2)
  t_me <- Sys.time()
  list_of_tables[[sprintf("Main_Effect_%s", f_within)]] <- format_posthoc_apa(
    pairs_with_ci(emmeans::emmeans(FINAL_MODEL,
                                   as.formula(sprintf("~ %s", f_within))),
                  adjust = "tukey"),
    scale_hint = scale_hint
  )
  progress_log(sprintf("[Main effect %s] done (%s).", f_within, format_elapsed(t_me)),
               indent = 3)
  
  progress_log("[Descriptive] estimated marginal means...", indent = 2)
  t_me <- Sys.time()
  list_of_tables[["Descriptive_Means"]] <- beautify_labels(kill_scipen(
    as.data.frame(emmeans::emmeans(FINAL_MODEL,
                                   as.formula(sprintf("~ %s * %s", f_within, f_between))))
  ))
  progress_log(sprintf("[Descriptive] done (%s).", format_elapsed(t_me)), indent = 3)
  
  progress_log("[Descriptive] cell-level raw statistics...", indent = 2)
  list_of_tables[["Cell_Descriptives"]] <- format_descriptives_table(
    data, group_vars = c(f_between, f_within)
  )
  
  # ---- Reporting Layer ----
  write_outputs_common(
    FINAL_MODEL = FINAL_MODEL,
    list_of_tables = list_of_tables,
    list_of_supp_tables = list_of_supp_tables,
    analysis_name = analysis_name,
    exp_version = exp_version,
    out_dir = out_dir,
    formula_str = formula_str,
    diag_log = diag_log,
    anova_apa = anova_apa,
    model_family = model_family,
    outcome_var = outcome_var
  )
  
  progress_log(">>> Analysis complete.", indent = 1)
  invisible(FINAL_MODEL)
}

# ==============================================================================
# 6. Stage 1 Runner: 3-way Integrative analysis.
# ==============================================================================
#
# Used for Integrative stage only. The 3-way model has the form:
#   outcome ~ Exp * (emotion + offer_type)^2  [for GLMM_rejection / LMM_RT_main]
#   outcome ~ Exp * (emotion + reaction)^2    [for LMM_RT_unfair]
#
# Post-hoc decomposition follows the Maxwell-Delaney layered strategy:
#   1. Always report omnibus 3-way Exp:emotion:offer_type
#   2. If 3-way p < confirmatory_alpha:
#      - Decompose into per-Exp 2-way (emotion x offer_type within E1, within E2)
#      - Report interaction-of-interactions contrasts (does emotion x offer_type
#        differ between Exp?)
#   3. If 3-way 0.05 <= p < 0.10:
#      - Same decomposition but routed to Supplementary
#   4. If 3-way not significant:
#      - Report 2-way Exp:emotion, Exp:offer_type, emotion:offer_type
#      - Decompose each based on its own significance
#      - Report main effects only for factors NOT in any significant 2-way
run_behavior_analysis_3way <- function(data, analysis_name, outcome_var,
                                       fixed_terms, include_terms,
                                       model_family, out_dir, exp_version,
                                       posthoc_factors = NULL,
                                       random_max_vars = c("emotion", "offer_type"),
                                       timeout_sec = 3600) {
  
  if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  
  progress_log(sprintf(">>> Analysis (3-way): %s [%s] (N_subj = %d, N_trial = %d)",
                       analysis_name, exp_version,
                       dplyr::n_distinct(data$participant_id_internal), nrow(data)))
  
  # ---- Fit Stage 1 model via Bates 5-step ----
  FINAL_MODEL <- fit_stage1_bates(data, outcome_var, fixed_terms,
                                  include_terms, model_family,
                                  random_max_vars = random_max_vars,
                                  group_name = "participant_id_internal",
                                  timeout_sec = timeout_sec)
  diag_log <- attr(FINAL_MODEL, "bates_diag")
  
  formula_str <- paste(deparse(formula(FINAL_MODEL)), collapse = " ")
  progress_log(sprintf("[Final model] %s", stringr::str_squish(formula_str)),
               indent = 1)
  
  # ---- Type III ANOVA (same cascade as 2-way) ----
  progress_log("[ANOVA] Computing Type III tests...", indent = 1)
  t_anova <- Sys.time()
  
  if (model_family == "binomial") {
    anova_res <- car::Anova(FINAL_MODEL, type = 3, test.statistic = "Chisq")
    diag_log$anova_method <- "Wald_chi_square_GLMM"
  } else {
    if (inherits(FINAL_MODEL, "merMod") &&
        !inherits(FINAL_MODEL, "lmerModLmerTest")) {
      FINAL_MODEL_lt <- tryCatch(
        lmerTest::as_lmerModLmerTest(FINAL_MODEL),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      if (!is.null(FINAL_MODEL_lt)) FINAL_MODEL <- FINAL_MODEL_lt
    }
    
    anova_res <- NULL
    method_used <- NA_character_
    
    anova_res <- tryCatch({
      res <- suppressWarnings(anova(FINAL_MODEL, type = 3, ddf = "Satterthwaite"))
      if (any(grepl("^Pr", colnames(res)))) {
        method_used <- "Satterthwaite_F"; res
      } else NULL
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    
    if (is.null(anova_res)) {
      anova_res <- tryCatch({
        res <- suppressWarnings(anova(FINAL_MODEL, type = 3, ddf = "Kenward-Roger"))
        if (any(grepl("^Pr", colnames(res)))) {
          method_used <- "Kenward_Roger_F"; res
        } else NULL
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
    }
    
    if (is.null(anova_res)) {
      anova_res <- car::Anova(FINAL_MODEL, type = 3, test.statistic = "Chisq")
      method_used <- "Wald_chi_square"
    }
    
    diag_log$anova_method <- method_used
  }
  
  progress_log(sprintf("[ANOVA] Method: %s. Elapsed: %s.",
                       diag_log$anova_method, format_elapsed(t_anova)),
               indent = 2)
  
  anova_apa <- format_anova_apa(anova_res, FINAL_MODEL)
  print(anova_apa %>% dplyr::select(Effect, APA_Report, Sig))
  
  # ---- Determine factor names from posthoc_factors ----
  # For Integrative GLMM_rejection / LMM_RT_main: factors = c("Exp", "emotion", "offer_type")
  # For Integrative LMM_RT_unfair:                factors = c("Exp", "emotion", "reaction")
  if (is.null(posthoc_factors)) {
    if (analysis_name == "LMM_RT_unfair") {
      posthoc_factors <- list(exp = "Exp", between = "emotion", within = "reaction")
    } else {
      posthoc_factors <- list(exp = "Exp", between = "emotion", within = "offer_type")
    }
  }
  f_exp     <- posthoc_factors$exp
  f_between <- posthoc_factors$between
  f_within  <- posthoc_factors$within
  
  scale_hint <- dplyr::case_when(
    model_family == "binomial" ~ "logit",
    outcome_var == "logRT"     ~ "logRT",
    TRUE                        ~ "raw"
  )
  
  pairs_with_ci <- function(emm, adjust = "fdr") {
    pp <- pairs(emm, adjust = adjust)
    summary(pp, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))
  }
  
  # ---- Helper: extract p-value for a named effect from anova table ----
  get_p_for_effect <- function(anova_obj, effect_name) {
    if (!effect_name %in% rownames(anova_obj)) return(NA_real_)
    for (pcol in c("Pr(>F)", "Pr(>Chisq)")) {
      if (pcol %in% colnames(anova_obj)) {
        val <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(anova_obj[effect_name, pcol]))
        if (length(val) == 1 && !is.na(val)) return(val)
      }
    }
    NA_real_
  }
  
  # ---- Extract p-values for all relevant terms ----
  # Effect name order can vary by car::Anova vs anova(lmerTest) output; try
  # both orderings.
  try_p <- function(...) {
    candidates <- c(...)
    for (nm in candidates) {
      p <- get_p_for_effect(anova_res, nm)
      if (!is.na(p)) return(p)
    }
    NA_real_
  }
  
  p_3way <- try_p(paste(f_exp, f_between, f_within, sep = ":"),
                  paste(f_exp, f_within, f_between, sep = ":"),
                  paste(f_between, f_exp, f_within, sep = ":"))
  p_exp_emo <- try_p(paste(f_exp, f_between, sep = ":"),
                     paste(f_between, f_exp, sep = ":"))
  p_exp_off <- try_p(paste(f_exp, f_within, sep = ":"),
                     paste(f_within, f_exp, sep = ":"))
  p_emo_off <- try_p(paste(f_between, f_within, sep = ":"),
                     paste(f_within, f_between, sep = ":"))
  p_exp_main <- try_p(f_exp)
  p_emo_main <- try_p(f_between)
  p_off_main <- try_p(f_within)
  
  progress_log(sprintf("[3-way decomposition] p_3way=%.4f, p_exp_emo=%.4f, p_exp_off=%.4f, p_emo_off=%.4f",
                       p_3way %||% NA, p_exp_emo %||% NA,
                       p_exp_off %||% NA, p_emo_off %||% NA), indent = 1)
  
  # Helper to classify p-value into status.
  classify <- function(p) {
    if (is.na(p)) return("Not_triggered")
    if (p < confirmatory_alpha) return("Confirmatory")
    if (p < marginal_threshold) return("Exploratory_Marginal")
    "Not_triggered"
  }
  
  status_3way <- classify(p_3way)
  
  list_of_tables <- list(
    "ANOVA_Main" = anova_apa,
    "Model_Formula" = data.frame(Formula = formula_str),
    "Model_Coefficients" = format_coefs(FINAL_MODEL),
    "R2_NakagawaSchielzeth" = extract_r2_table(FINAL_MODEL, analysis_name)
  )
  list_of_supp_tables <- list()
  
  # Helper to route a posthoc table by its status (confirmatory vs marginal).
  route_table <- function(name, tbl, status) {
    if (status == "Confirmatory") {
      list_of_tables[[name]] <<- tbl
    } else if (status == "Exploratory_Marginal") {
      list_of_supp_tables[[paste0("MARGINAL_", name)]] <<- tbl
    }
  }
  
  # ====== DECOMPOSITION LAYER ======
  
  if (status_3way %in% c("Confirmatory", "Exploratory_Marginal")) {
    # ---- Branch A: 3-way is (at least marginally) significant ----
    # Report per-Exp emotion x within-factor interaction, plus
    # interaction-of-interactions contrast.
    progress_log(sprintf("[3-way DECOMP] Branch A: 3-way p=%.4f -> %s. Per-Exp decomposition.",
                         p_3way, status_3way), indent = 1)
    
    # A1: simple emotion x within-factor interaction within each Exp.
    # We do this via emmeans::joint_tests with by=Exp, which gives per-Exp
    # joint tests of every fixed effect interaction inside Exp.
    progress_log("[3-way DECOMP A1] Joint tests within each Exp...", indent = 2)
    t_jt <- Sys.time()
    joint_per_exp <- tryCatch({
      jt <- emmeans::joint_tests(FINAL_MODEL, by = f_exp)
      beautify_labels(kill_scipen(as.data.frame(jt)))
    }, error = function(e) {
      progress_log(sprintf("[WARN] joint_tests failed: %s", conditionMessage(e)),
                   indent = 3)
      NULL
    })
    progress_log(sprintf("[3-way DECOMP A1] done (%s).", format_elapsed(t_jt)),
                 indent = 3)
    if (!is.null(joint_per_exp)) {
      route_table("JointTests_within_Exp", joint_per_exp, status_3way)
    }
    
    # A2: simple "within-factor" effect within each (Exp, between-factor) cell.
    # E.g., effect of offer_type at each (Exp, emotion).
    progress_log(sprintf("[3-way DECOMP A2] %s | %s * %s (FDR)...",
                         f_within, f_between, f_exp), indent = 2)
    t_ph <- Sys.time()
    f_A2 <- as.formula(sprintf("~ %s | %s * %s", f_within, f_between, f_exp))
    tbl_A2 <- format_posthoc_apa(
      pairs_with_ci(emmeans::emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, f_A2), adjust = "fdr"),
      scale_hint = scale_hint
    )
    tbl_A2$Status <- status_3way
    progress_log(sprintf("[3-way DECOMP A2] done (%s).", format_elapsed(t_ph)),
                 indent = 3)
    route_table(sprintf("Simple_%s_by_%s_x_%s", f_within, f_between, f_exp),
                tbl_A2, status_3way)
    
    # A3: simple "between-factor" effect within each (Exp, within-factor) cell.
    # E.g., emotion pairwise at each (Exp, offer_type).
    progress_log(sprintf("[3-way DECOMP A3] %s | %s * %s (FDR)...",
                         f_between, f_within, f_exp), indent = 2)
    t_ph <- Sys.time()
    f_A3 <- as.formula(sprintf("~ %s | %s * %s", f_between, f_within, f_exp))
    tbl_A3 <- format_posthoc_apa(
      pairs_with_ci(emmeans::emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, f_A3), adjust = "fdr"),
      scale_hint = scale_hint
    )
    tbl_A3$Status <- status_3way
    progress_log(sprintf("[3-way DECOMP A3] done (%s).", format_elapsed(t_ph)),
                 indent = 3)
    route_table(sprintf("Simple_%s_by_%s_x_%s", f_between, f_within, f_exp),
                tbl_A3, status_3way)
    
    # A4: Interaction-of-interactions. Does the (emotion x within-factor)
    # interaction pattern differ between E1 and E2?
    # Formula: ~ between * within | Exp, then interaction = "pairwise" gives
    # the interaction contrast at each Exp; we then need to contrast THOSE
    # across Exp. emmeans's contrast(..., interaction=...) returns the
    # per-Exp interaction effect; comparing across Exp requires another step.
    # Simpler: do the cross-Exp interaction contrast directly:
    #   ~ between * within * Exp, interaction = "pairwise"
    progress_log("[3-way DECOMP A4] Interaction-of-interactions contrasts (FDR)...",
                 indent = 2)
    t_ph <- Sys.time()
    f_A4 <- as.formula(sprintf("~ %s * %s * %s", f_between, f_within, f_exp))
    tbl_A4 <- format_posthoc_apa(
      summary(contrast(emmeans::emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, f_A4),
                       interaction = "pairwise", adjust = "fdr"),
              infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)),
      scale_hint = scale_hint
    )
    tbl_A4$Status <- status_3way
    progress_log(sprintf("[3-way DECOMP A4] done (%s).", format_elapsed(t_ph)),
                 indent = 3)
    route_table("Interaction_of_Interactions_3way", tbl_A4, status_3way)
    
  } else {
    # ---- Branch B: 3-way not significant ----
    # Report each 2-way interaction with its own decomposition.
    progress_log(sprintf("[3-way DECOMP] Branch B: 3-way p=%.4f -> Not_triggered. Per-2-way decomposition.",
                         p_3way %||% NA), indent = 1)
    
    factors_in_sig_2way <- c()
    
    # B1: emotion x within-factor (the core within-subject pattern, pooled
    # across Exp).
    s_emo_off <- classify(p_emo_off)
    if (s_emo_off %in% c("Confirmatory", "Exploratory_Marginal")) {
      progress_log(sprintf("[3-way DECOMP B1] %s x %s 2-way (p=%.4f, %s).",
                           f_between, f_within, p_emo_off, s_emo_off), indent = 2)
      f_B1a <- as.formula(sprintf("~ %s | %s", f_within, f_between))
      tbl_B1a <- format_posthoc_apa(
        pairs_with_ci(emmeans::emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, f_B1a), adjust = "fdr"),
        scale_hint = scale_hint)
      tbl_B1a$Status <- s_emo_off
      route_table(sprintf("Simple_%s_by_%s", f_within, f_between), tbl_B1a, s_emo_off)
      
      f_B1b <- as.formula(sprintf("~ %s | %s", f_between, f_within))
      tbl_B1b <- format_posthoc_apa(
        pairs_with_ci(emmeans::emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, f_B1b), adjust = "fdr"),
        scale_hint = scale_hint)
      tbl_B1b$Status <- s_emo_off
      route_table(sprintf("Simple_%s_by_%s", f_between, f_within), tbl_B1b, s_emo_off)
      
      factors_in_sig_2way <- c(factors_in_sig_2way, f_between, f_within)
    }
    
    # B2: Exp x emotion.
    s_exp_emo <- classify(p_exp_emo)
    if (s_exp_emo %in% c("Confirmatory", "Exploratory_Marginal")) {
      progress_log(sprintf("[3-way DECOMP B2] %s x %s 2-way (p=%.4f, %s).",
                           f_exp, f_between, p_exp_emo, s_exp_emo), indent = 2)
      f_B2 <- as.formula(sprintf("~ %s | %s", f_between, f_exp))
      tbl_B2 <- format_posthoc_apa(
        pairs_with_ci(emmeans::emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, f_B2), adjust = "fdr"),
        scale_hint = scale_hint)
      tbl_B2$Status <- s_exp_emo
      route_table(sprintf("Simple_%s_by_%s", f_between, f_exp), tbl_B2, s_exp_emo)
      factors_in_sig_2way <- c(factors_in_sig_2way, f_exp, f_between)
    }
    
    # B3: Exp x within-factor.
    s_exp_off <- classify(p_exp_off)
    if (s_exp_off %in% c("Confirmatory", "Exploratory_Marginal")) {
      progress_log(sprintf("[3-way DECOMP B3] %s x %s 2-way (p=%.4f, %s).",
                           f_exp, f_within, p_exp_off, s_exp_off), indent = 2)
      f_B3 <- as.formula(sprintf("~ %s | %s", f_within, f_exp))
      tbl_B3 <- format_posthoc_apa(
        pairs_with_ci(emmeans::emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, f_B3), adjust = "fdr"),
        scale_hint = scale_hint)
      tbl_B3$Status <- s_exp_off
      route_table(sprintf("Simple_%s_by_%s", f_within, f_exp), tbl_B3, s_exp_off)
      factors_in_sig_2way <- c(factors_in_sig_2way, f_exp, f_within)
    }
    
    # B4: Main effects for factors NOT involved in any significant 2-way.
    factors_in_sig_2way <- unique(factors_in_sig_2way)
    for (fnm in c(f_exp, f_between, f_within)) {
      if (fnm %in% factors_in_sig_2way) next
      p_main <- switch(fnm, "Exp" = p_exp_main,
                       "emotion" = p_emo_main,
                       "offer_type" = p_off_main,
                       "reaction" = p_off_main,
                       NA)
      s_main <- classify(p_main)
      if (s_main %in% c("Confirmatory", "Exploratory_Marginal")) {
        progress_log(sprintf("[3-way DECOMP B4] Main effect %s (p=%.4f, %s).",
                             fnm, p_main, s_main), indent = 2)
        f_B4 <- as.formula(sprintf("~ %s", fnm))
        tbl_B4 <- format_posthoc_apa(
          pairs_with_ci(emmeans::emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, f_B4),
                        adjust = "tukey"),
          scale_hint = scale_hint)
        tbl_B4$Status <- s_main
        route_table(sprintf("MainEffect_%s", fnm), tbl_B4, s_main)
      }
    }
  }
  
  # ---- ALWAYS report descriptive emmeans and cell-level statistics ----
  progress_log("[Descriptive] Estimated marginal means (3-way grid)...", indent = 2)
  t_me <- Sys.time()
  list_of_tables[["Descriptive_Means"]] <- beautify_labels(kill_scipen(
    as.data.frame(emmeans::emmeans(FINAL_MODEL,
                                   as.formula(sprintf("~ %s * %s * %s",
                                                       f_exp, f_between, f_within))))
  ))
  progress_log(sprintf("[Descriptive] done (%s).", format_elapsed(t_me)), indent = 3)
  
  progress_log("[Descriptive] Cell-level raw statistics...", indent = 2)
  list_of_tables[["Cell_Descriptives"]] <- format_descriptives_table(
    data, group_vars = c(f_exp, f_between, f_within)
  )
  
  # ---- Reporting Layer ----
  write_outputs_common(
    FINAL_MODEL = FINAL_MODEL,
    list_of_tables = list_of_tables,
    list_of_supp_tables = list_of_supp_tables,
    analysis_name = analysis_name,
    exp_version = exp_version,
    out_dir = out_dir,
    formula_str = formula_str,
    diag_log = diag_log,
    anova_apa = anova_apa,
    model_family = model_family,
    outcome_var = outcome_var
  )
  
  progress_log(">>> Analysis (3-way) complete.", indent = 1)
  invisible(FINAL_MODEL)
}

# ==============================================================================
# Shared output writer used by both 2-way and 3-way runners.
# ==============================================================================
write_outputs_common <- function(FINAL_MODEL, list_of_tables, list_of_supp_tables,
                                  analysis_name, exp_version, out_dir,
                                  formula_str, diag_log, anova_apa,
                                  model_family, outcome_var) {
  
  # 1. REPRODUCIBILITY metadata.
  sink(file.path(out_dir, "REPRODUCIBILITY.txt"))
  cat("# Reproducibility log for behavioral analysis:", analysis_name, "\n")
  cat("# Stage:", exp_version, "\n")
  cat("# Generated:", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "\n\n")
  write_stage_input_provenance(exp_version)
  cat("## Final formula:\n")
  cat(formula_str, "\n\n")
  cat("## Software versions:\n")
  cat("R:        ", R.version.string, "\n")
  cat("lme4:     ", as.character(packageVersion("lme4")), "\n")
  cat("lmerTest: ", as.character(packageVersion("lmerTest")), "\n")
  cat("glmmTMB:  ", as.character(packageVersion("glmmTMB")), "\n")
  cat("buildmer: ", as.character(packageVersion("buildmer")), "\n")
  cat("emmeans:  ", as.character(packageVersion("emmeans")), "\n\n")
  cat("## Model family:    ", model_family, "\n")
  cat("## Engine:          ", if (inherits(FINAL_MODEL, "glmmTMB")) "glmmTMB"
                              else if (inherits(FINAL_MODEL, "merMod")) "lme4"
                              else class(FINAL_MODEL)[1], "\n")
  cat("## Outcome variable:", outcome_var, "\n")
  cat("## Convergence:\n")

  final_validation <- attr(FINAL_MODEL, "final_validation") %||%
    mixed_model_diagnostics(FINAL_MODEL, require_derivatives = TRUE)
  cat("Acceptance gate passed:", final_validation$valid, "\n")
  cat("Optimizer code:         ", final_validation$optimizer_code, "\n")
  cat("Convergence messages:   ",
      ifelse(nchar(final_validation$convergence_messages) == 0,
             "none", final_validation$convergence_messages), "\n")
  cat("Singular fit:           ", final_validation$singular, "\n")
  cat("Hessian available:      ", final_validation$hessian_available, "\n")
  cat("Hessian positive-definite:",
      final_validation$hessian_positive_definite, "\n")
  cat("Finite fixed-effect SE: ", final_validation$finite_fixed_se, "\n")
  cat("Finite likelihood/AIC:  ", final_validation$finite_likelihood, "\n")
  cat("Final optimizer:        ",
      attr(FINAL_MODEL, "final_refit_optimizer") %||% "unknown", "\n")
  cat("Final random tier:      ",
      attr(FINAL_MODEL, "final_random_tier") %||% "selected_formula", "\n")
  cat("Observations:", nobs(FINAL_MODEL), "\n")
  
  ngrps_final <- if (inherits(FINAL_MODEL, "glmmTMB")) {
    ng <- summary(FINAL_MODEL)$ngrps$cond
    ng[1]
  } else {
    lme4::ngrps(FINAL_MODEL)[1]
  }
  cat("Subjects:    ", ngrps_final, "\n\n")
  cat("## Bates 5-step diagnostic log:\n")
  
  step3_method_str <- diag_log$step3_method %||% "buildmer_LRT"
  if (step3_method_str == "buildglmmTMB_LRT") {
    cat("Step 3 method:               buildmer::buildglmmTMB() LRT (GLMM)\n")
  } else {
    cat("Step 3 method:               buildmer::buildmer() LRT (LMM)\n")
  }
  cat("Term ordering criterion:     LRT (default)\n")
  cat("Term elimination criterion:  LRTalpha(0.20) (Matuschek et al., 2017)\n")
  cat("Buildmer timeout (sec):      ", diag_log$timeout_sec %||% "NA", "\n")
  cat("Engineering protections:     lmerTest detached during buildmer call;\n")
  cat("                             withTimeout protection; stop on selection failure.\n")
  if (!is.na(diag_log$step3_fallback %||% NA_character_)) {
    cat("Step 3 fallback triggered:  ", diag_log$step3_fallback, "\n")
  }
  cat("Random max vars:             ",
      paste(diag_log$random_max_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("Random contrast columns:     ",
      paste(diag_log$random_contrast_columns %||% character(0), collapse = ", "),
      "\n")
  cat("Random slope blocks:         ",
      paste(diag_log$random_slope_blocks %||% character(0), collapse = ", "),
      "\n")
  cat("Group name:                  ", diag_log$group_name, "\n")
  cat("Step 1 (Maximal):           ", diag_log$step1_status, "\n")
  if (!is.null(diag_log$step1_pca)) {
    cat("  Step 1 effective/nominal: ",
        count_effective_dims(diag_log$step1_pca), "/",
        nrow(diag_log$step1_pca), "\n")
  }
  cat("Step 2 (ZCP):               ", diag_log$step2_status, "\n")
  cat("Step 3 final formula:       ", diag_log$step3_final_formula %||% "n/a", "\n")
  cat("Step 4 (correlations):      ", diag_log$step4_status, "\n")
  cat("Step 5 (final dims):        ",
      count_effective_dims(diag_log$step5_pca), "/",
      nrow(diag_log$step5_pca), "\n")
  cat("\n## Inferential method:\n")
  cat("ANOVA test:                 ", diag_log$anova_method %||% "Wald_chi_square", "\n")
  if (identical(diag_log$anova_method, "Wald_chi_square")) {
    cat("Note: Satterthwaite was attempted but failed (no p-value column or\n")
    cat("error). Wald chi-square (car::Anova) used as fallback.\n")
  }
  if (model_family == "binomial") {
    cat("\n## GLMM estimation & overdispersion:\n")
    cat("Estimation:     maximum likelihood, Laplace approximation (glmmTMB).\n")
    cat("Overdispersion: responses are Bernoulli (0/1); observation-level\n")
    cat("                overdispersion is not identifiable (Var = p(1-p), fixed\n")
    cat("                by the mean), so no scale/dispersion parameter was\n")
    cat("                estimated. Wald chi-square is appropriate (Bolker\n")
    cat("                et al., 2009).\n")
  }
  sink()
  
  # 2. Full model summary.
  sink(file.path(out_dir, "summary_text.txt"))
  print(summary(FINAL_MODEL))
  sink()

  # 2b. LMM residual-assumption diagnostics (Gaussian only; Meteyard & Davies
  # 2020, Table 7 "Assumptions"). Best-effort; never blocks the analysis.
  if (model_family == "gaussian") {
    tryCatch(lmm_assumption_diagnostics(FINAL_MODEL, analysis_name, out_dir),
             error = function(e) NULL)
  }

  # 3. ANOVA table in markdown.
  writeLines(
    knitr::kable(anova_apa, format = "markdown",
                 caption = sprintf("Type III ANOVA (%s), %s.",
                                   diag_log$anova_method %||% "unknown", analysis_name)),
    con = file.path(out_dir, "anova_apa.md")
  )
  
  # 4. Post-hoc tables (main).
  for (nm in names(list_of_tables)) {
    safe_nm <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", nm)
    writeLines(
      knitr::kable(list_of_tables[[nm]], format = "markdown",
                   caption = sprintf("%s -- %s", analysis_name, nm)),
      con = file.path(out_dir, sprintf("posthoc_%s.md", safe_nm))
    )
  }
  
  # 5. Step 4 LRT (when applicable).
  step4_lrt <- attr(FINAL_MODEL, "step4_lrt_table")
  if (!is.null(step4_lrt) && nrow(step4_lrt) > 0) {
    writeLines(
      knitr::kable(kill_scipen(step4_lrt), format = "markdown",
                   caption = sprintf("Step 4 candidate-correlation LRT, %s.", analysis_name)),
      con = file.path(out_dir, "step4_correlation_lrt.md")
    )
  }
  
  # 6. Bates rePCA.
  if (!is.null(diag_log$step5_pca) && !all(is.na(diag_log$step5_pca$component))) {
    writeLines(
      knitr::kable(kill_scipen(diag_log$step5_pca), format = "markdown",
                   caption = sprintf("Final-model rePCA dimensionality, %s.", analysis_name)),
      con = file.path(out_dir, "step5_rePCA.md")
    )
  }
  
  # 7. Supplementary marginal tables.
  if (length(list_of_supp_tables) > 0) {
    # Suppl directory sits alongside per-analysis output, NOT inside out_dir.
    # We compute it by walking up one level (out_dir is e.g.
    # results/Behavior/E1_TwoStage_Bates/GLMM_Rejection/; parent is the stage
    # root, and Supplementary/ is a sibling of GLMM_Rejection/).
    stage_root <- dirname(out_dir)
    supp_subdir <- file.path(stage_root, "Supplementary",
                             sprintf("%s_marginal_contrasts", analysis_name))
    if (!dir.exists(supp_subdir)) dir.create(supp_subdir, recursive = TRUE)
    for (nm in names(list_of_supp_tables)) {
      safe_nm <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", nm)
      writeLines(
        knitr::kable(list_of_supp_tables[[nm]], format = "markdown",
                     caption = sprintf("%s -- %s (omnibus interaction p in [%.2f, %.2f); EXPLORATORY ONLY)",
                                       analysis_name, nm,
                                       confirmatory_alpha, marginal_threshold)),
        con = file.path(supp_subdir, sprintf("%s.md", safe_nm))
      )
    }
    progress_log(sprintf("[Supplementary] %d marginal table(s) written to %s",
                         length(list_of_supp_tables),
                         file.path("Supplementary",
                                   sprintf("%s_marginal_contrasts", analysis_name))),
                 indent = 1)
  }
  
  # 8. Save the fitted model object for downstream re-extraction.
  rds_path <- file.path(out_dir, sprintf("final_model_%s.rds", analysis_name))
  saveRDS(FINAL_MODEL, file = rds_path)
  progress_log(sprintf("[Save] Model object: %s", basename(rds_path)), indent = 1)
  
  # 9. Excel export.
  wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
  for (sheet_name in names(list_of_tables)) {
    safe_sheet <- substr(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", sheet_name), 1, 31)
    openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, safe_sheet)
    openxlsx::writeData(wb, safe_sheet, list_of_tables[[sheet_name]])
    openxlsx::addStyle(wb, safe_sheet,
      openxlsx::createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", border = "Bottom"),
      rows = 1, cols = 1:ncol(list_of_tables[[sheet_name]]))
  }
  openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb,
    file.path(out_dir, sprintf("STATS_%s_%s.xlsx", exp_version, analysis_name)),
    overwrite = TRUE)
}
```

``` {r multi-summary}
# ==============================================================================
# Multi-analysis side-by-side summary report for one stage.
# Produces both HTML (via sjPlot::tab_model) and markdown fallback.
# ==============================================================================
report_behavior_multi <- function(model_list, exp_version, out_dir) {
  if (length(model_list) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))
  
  out_html <- file.path(out_dir, sprintf("Behavior_AllAnalyses_%s.html", exp_version))
  out_md   <- file.path(out_dir, sprintf("Behavior_AllAnalyses_%s.md", exp_version))
  
  # ---- HTML output via sjPlot::tab_model ----
  tab_model_succeeded <- FALSE
  tryCatch({
    sjPlot::tab_model(
      model_list,
      show.se = TRUE, show.stat = TRUE, show.ci = FALSE,
      string.se = "SE", string.stat = "stat", string.p = "p-value",
      show.re.var = TRUE, show.obs = TRUE, show.icc = FALSE,
      show.r2 = TRUE, show.loglik = TRUE, show.dev = TRUE,
      emph.p = TRUE, p.style = "numeric_stars",
      file = out_html,
      dv.labels = names(model_list)
    )
    if (file.exists(out_html) && file.size(out_html) > 0) {
      cat(sprintf("[Multi-analysis HTML] %s\n", basename(out_html)))
      tab_model_succeeded <- TRUE
    } else {
      cat(sprintf("[WARN] tab_model returned without error but no file written: %s\n",
                  out_html))
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(sprintf("[WARN] tab_model failed: %s\n", conditionMessage(e)))
  })
  
  # ---- Markdown fallback ----
  tryCatch({
    rows <- list()
    methods_log <- character(0)
    for (a_name in names(model_list)) {
      mdl <- model_list[[a_name]]
      
      anova_obj <- NULL
      method_used <- NA_character_
      
      if (inherits(mdl, c("glmerMod", "glmmTMB"))) {
        anova_obj <- tryCatch(
          car::Anova(mdl, type = 3, test.statistic = "Chisq"),
          error = function(e) NULL
        )
        if (!is.null(anova_obj)) method_used <- "Wald chi-square (GLMM)"
      } else if (inherits(mdl, "merMod")) {
        if (!inherits(mdl, "lmerModLmerTest")) {
          mdl_upgraded <- tryCatch(
            lmerTest::as_lmerModLmerTest(mdl),
            error = function(e) NULL
          )
          if (!is.null(mdl_upgraded)) mdl <- mdl_upgraded
        }
        
        anova_obj <- tryCatch({
          res <- suppressWarnings(anova(mdl, type = 3, ddf = "Satterthwaite"))
          if (any(grepl("^Pr", colnames(res)))) {
            method_used <- "Satterthwaite F"; res
          } else NULL
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
        
        if (is.null(anova_obj)) {
          anova_obj <- tryCatch({
            res <- suppressWarnings(anova(mdl, type = 3, ddf = "Kenward-Roger"))
            if (any(grepl("^Pr", colnames(res)))) {
              method_used <- "Kenward-Roger F"; res
            } else NULL
          }, error = function(e) NULL)
        }
        
        if (is.null(anova_obj)) {
          anova_obj <- tryCatch(
            car::Anova(mdl, type = 3, test.statistic = "Chisq"),
            error = function(e) NULL
          )
          if (!is.null(anova_obj)) {
            method_used <- "Wald chi-square (LMM fallback)"
          }
        }
      }
      
      if (is.null(anova_obj)) next
      
      methods_log <- c(methods_log, sprintf("%s: %s", a_name, method_used))
      apa <- format_anova_apa(anova_obj, mdl)
      apa$Analysis <- a_name
      apa$Method <- method_used
      rows[[a_name]] <- apa[, c("Analysis", "Effect", "APA_Report", "Sig", "Method")]
    }
    
    if (length(rows) > 0) {
      combined <- do.call(rbind, rows)
      writeLines(
        c(sprintf("# Behavioral Analysis Summary, %s", exp_version),
          sprintf("Generated: %s", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")),
          "",
          "Type III ANOVA tests. LMM analyses use a Satterthwaite -> ",
          "Kenward-Roger -> Wald cascade (lmerTest, pbkrtest, car). GLMM ",
          "analyses use Wald chi-square (car::Anova) as the only valid ",
          "method (Satterthwaite is undefined for non-Gaussian likelihoods). ",
          "The actual method used per analysis is shown in the Method column.",
          "",
          "## Methods used per analysis:",
          paste0("- ", methods_log),
          "",
          knitr::kable(combined, format = "markdown",
                       caption = sprintf("Behavioral fixed-effect tests across %d analyses.",
                                         length(rows)))),
        con = out_md
      )
      cat(sprintf("[Multi-analysis Markdown] %s\n", basename(out_md)))
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(sprintf("[WARN] Markdown multi-analysis summary failed: %s\n",
                conditionMessage(e)))
  })
  
  invisible(list(html_ok = tab_model_succeeded, html_path = out_html, md_path = out_md))
}
```
