``` {r execution-three-stage}
# ==============================================================================
# 7. Execution: Three-Stage Loop
# ==============================================================================
# For each stage (E1, E2, Integrative):
#   1. Build stage-specific output directory tree.
#   2. Load data (single-experiment loader or integrative loader).
#   3. Build subset for unfair-only analysis.
#   4. Run all configured analyses.
#   5. Write stage-level multi-analysis summary.
#   6. Write stage-specific Methods paragraph.

# Pipeline-wide accumulator for cross-stage final summary.
all_stage_models <- list()
pipeline_t0 <- Sys.time()

for (stage in stages_to_run) {
  
  progress_log(sprintf("\n%s\n>>> STAGE: %s (cumulative pipeline elapsed: %s)\n%s",
                       strrep("=", 70), stage,
                       format_elapsed(pipeline_t0),
                       strrep("=", 70)))
  
  # ---- Stage-specific output directory ----
  out_root_stage <- file.path(out_root_base, sprintf("%s_TwoStage_Bates", stage))
  out_glmm       <- file.path(out_root_stage, "GLMM_Rejection")
  out_lmm_main   <- file.path(out_root_stage, "LMM_RT_main")
  out_lmm_unfair <- file.path(out_root_stage, "LMM_RT_unfair")
  out_tables     <- file.path(out_root_stage, "Tables_Manuscript")
  out_suppl      <- file.path(out_root_stage, "Supplementary")
  for (d in c(out_root_stage, out_glmm, out_lmm_main, out_lmm_unfair,
              out_tables, out_suppl)) {
    if (!dir.exists(d)) dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  # ---- Per-stage buildmer timeout ----
  stage_timeout <- buildmer_timeout_map[[stage]] %||% 1800
  progress_log(sprintf("[%s] buildmer timeout set to %d sec.",
                       stage, stage_timeout))
  
  # ---- Load data ----
  if (stage %in% c("E1", "E2")) {
    path_pipeline <- here("data", paste0("02_Pipeline_Output_", stage))
    path_trials <- file.path(path_pipeline, "Method_Regression",
                              "Stimulus_Locked", "trials.csv")
    if (!file.exists(path_trials)) {
      stop(sprintf("Trial file not found for %s: %s\nVerify upstream preprocessing.",
                   stage, path_trials))
    }
    
    cat(sprintf("\n--- Loading and preparing behavioral data for %s ---\n", stage))
    df_clean <- load_single_experiment(path_trials, stage)
    
  } else if (stage == "Integrative") {
    path_E1 <- here("data", "02_Pipeline_Output_E1",
                    "Method_Regression", "Stimulus_Locked", "trials.csv")
    path_E2 <- here("data", "02_Pipeline_Output_E2",
                    "Method_Regression", "Stimulus_Locked", "trials.csv")
    
    cat("\n--- Loading and preparing INTEGRATIVE behavioral data (E1 + E2) ---\n")
    df_clean <- load_integrative(path_E1, path_E2)
    
  } else {
    stop(sprintf("Unknown stage: %s", stage))
  }
  
  # ---- Subset for unfair-only analysis ----
  df_unfair <- df_clean %>% dplyr::filter(offer_type == "unfair")
  cat(sprintf("\n[%s] Unfair-only subset: %d trials, %d subjects\n",
              stage, nrow(df_unfair),
              dplyr::n_distinct(df_unfair$participant_id_internal)))
  
  # ---- Uniqueness check ----
  check_uniqueness(df_clean,
                    sprintf("df_clean (%s)", stage))
  check_uniqueness(df_unfair,
                    sprintf("df_unfair (%s)", stage))
  
  # ---- Run all configured analyses ----
  behavior_models <- list()
  total_analyses <- length(analyses_to_run)
  stage_t0 <- Sys.time()
  
  for (a_idx in seq_along(analyses_to_run)) {
    a_name <- analyses_to_run[a_idx]
    
    progress_log(sprintf(">>> [%s | %d/%d] Analysis: %s (stage elapsed: %s)",
                         stage, a_idx, total_analyses, a_name,
                         format_elapsed(stage_t0)))
    
    # ---- Configure analysis: differs between single-exp and Integrative ----
    config <- NULL
    
    if (stage %in% c("E1", "E2")) {
      # ---- 2-way model configurations ----
      config <- switch(a_name,
        "GLMM_rejection" = list(
          mode = "2way",
          data = df_clean,
          outcome = "reject_binary",
          fixed_terms = "(emotion + offer_type)^2",
          include = c("emotion", "offer_type", "emotion:offer_type"),
          family = "binomial",
          out = out_glmm,
          posthoc = list(within = "offer_type", between = "emotion"),
          random_max_vars = c("emotion", "offer_type")
        ),
        "LMM_RT_main" = list(
          mode = "2way",
          data = df_clean,
          outcome = "logRT",
          fixed_terms = "(emotion + offer_type)^2",
          include = c("emotion", "offer_type", "emotion:offer_type"),
          family = "gaussian",
          out = out_lmm_main,
          posthoc = list(within = "offer_type", between = "emotion"),
          random_max_vars = c("emotion", "offer_type")
        ),
        "LMM_RT_unfair" = list(
          mode = "2way",
          data = df_unfair,
          outcome = "logRT",
          fixed_terms = "(emotion + reaction)^2",
          include = c("emotion", "reaction", "emotion:reaction"),
          family = "gaussian",
          out = out_lmm_unfair,
          posthoc = list(within = "reaction", between = "emotion"),
          random_max_vars = c("emotion", "reaction")
        ),
        NULL
      )
      
    } else if (stage == "Integrative") {
      # ---- 3-way model configurations ----
      # Exp is between-subjects: enters as fixed factor but NOT in random
      # slopes. The 3-way fixed structure uses ^3 to include all interactions
      # up to Exp x emotion x within-factor.
      config <- switch(a_name,
        "GLMM_rejection" = list(
          mode = "3way",
          data = df_clean,
          outcome = "reject_binary",
          fixed_terms = "(Exp + emotion + offer_type)^3",
          include = c("Exp", "emotion", "offer_type",
                      "Exp:emotion", "Exp:offer_type", "emotion:offer_type",
                      "Exp:emotion:offer_type"),
          family = "binomial",
          out = out_glmm,
          posthoc = list(exp = "Exp", between = "emotion", within = "offer_type"),
          random_max_vars = c("emotion", "offer_type")
        ),
        "LMM_RT_main" = list(
          mode = "3way",
          data = df_clean,
          outcome = "logRT",
          fixed_terms = "(Exp + emotion + offer_type)^3",
          include = c("Exp", "emotion", "offer_type",
                      "Exp:emotion", "Exp:offer_type", "emotion:offer_type",
                      "Exp:emotion:offer_type"),
          family = "gaussian",
          out = out_lmm_main,
          posthoc = list(exp = "Exp", between = "emotion", within = "offer_type"),
          random_max_vars = c("emotion", "offer_type")
        ),
        "LMM_RT_unfair" = list(
          mode = "3way",
          data = df_unfair,
          outcome = "logRT",
          fixed_terms = "(Exp + emotion + reaction)^3",
          include = c("Exp", "emotion", "reaction",
                      "Exp:emotion", "Exp:reaction", "emotion:reaction",
                      "Exp:emotion:reaction"),
          family = "gaussian",
          out = out_lmm_unfair,
          posthoc = list(exp = "Exp", between = "emotion", within = "reaction"),
          random_max_vars = c("emotion", "reaction")
        ),
        NULL
      )
    }
    
    if (is.null(config)) {
      progress_log(sprintf("[SKIP] Unknown analysis or unsupported stage/analysis combination: %s | %s",
                           stage, a_name))
      next
    }
    
    # Verify freshly loaded data against the original fit before selection.
    reference_fixed <- revision_reference(config$data, paste("Behavior", stage, a_name, sep = "__"), config$out)
    stopifnot(setequal(attr(terms(reference_fixed), "term.labels"),
                       attr(terms(as.formula(paste(config$outcome, "~", config$fixed_terms))), "term.labels")))
    if (isTRUE(getOption("ug.preflight_only", FALSE))) next

    # ---- Dispatch to 2-way or 3-way runner ----
    fit <- tryCatch({
      if (config$mode == "2way") {
        run_behavior_analysis(
          data = config$data,
          analysis_name = a_name,
          outcome_var = config$outcome,
          fixed_terms = config$fixed_terms,
          include_terms = config$include,
          model_family = config$family,
          out_dir = config$out,
          exp_version = stage,
          posthoc_factors = config$posthoc,
          random_max_vars = config$random_max_vars,
          timeout_sec = stage_timeout
        )
      } else {
        run_behavior_analysis_3way(
          data = config$data,
          analysis_name = a_name,
          outcome_var = config$outcome,
          fixed_terms = config$fixed_terms,
          include_terms = config$include,
          model_family = config$family,
          out_dir = config$out,
          exp_version = stage,
          posthoc_factors = config$posthoc,
          random_max_vars = config$random_max_vars,
          timeout_sec = stage_timeout
        )
      }
    }, error = function(e) {
      progress_log(sprintf("[ERROR] %s | %s failed: %s",
                           stage, a_name, conditionMessage(e)))
      NULL
    })
    
    if (!is.null(fit)) {
      behavior_models[[a_name]] <- fit
    }
    progress_log(sprintf(">>> [%s | %d/%d] %s complete.",
                         stage, a_idx, total_analyses, a_name))
  }
  
  # ---- Stage-level multi-analysis summary table ----
  report_behavior_multi(behavior_models, stage, out_tables)
  
  # ---- Stage-specific Methods paragraph ----
  # Note: per-stage Methods text is generated inside this loop so that the
  # sample-size summary inside it reflects the data actually used by the
  # current stage.
  if (stage %in% c("E1", "E2")) {
    stage_subtitle <- sprintf("Experiment %s (single-experiment analyses)", stage)
    stage_models_summary <- sprintf(
      "Models fitted in this stage:\n
1. **Rejection rate (GLMM_rejection):** binomial mixed-effects model on reject_binary
   with predictors emotion (5 levels) x offer type (fair, unfair) and their interaction.

2. **Response time, main analysis (LMM_RT_main):** linear mixed-effects model on
   log RT with predictors emotion x offer type and their interaction. Reaction was
   deliberately NOT included as a covariate (collider; Rohrer, 2018).

3. **Response time, unfair-only (LMM_RT_unfair):** linear mixed-effects model
   on log RT restricted to unfair trials, with predictors emotion x reaction
   and their interaction. This stratum parallels HDDM decision-dynamics
   modeling.

4. **Exploratory individual-differences screen (Trait_MainEffects):** as a
   separate exploratory analysis, each of 10 z-scored subject-level variables
   (Social Value Orientation [SVO_angle]; the six PID5BF+ personality domains;
   and the three post-task belief ratings) was added one at a time as a single
   between-subjects MAIN-EFFECT covariate to the rejection (GLMM) and main RT
   (LMM) models above, reusing each model's design-selected random structure. No
   trait x design interaction was fitted, so a significant covariate indexes an
   overall shift in rejection or RT, not moderation of the emotion or fairness
   effects. Effects are reported per +1 SD with 95%% CIs and Benjamini-Hochberg
   FDR within family (SVO / PID5BF+ / Ratings); given n ~= 30 they are
   interpreted as exploratory. Output:
   results/Behavior/<EXP>_TwoStage_Bates/Trait_MainEffects/.")
  } else if (stage == "Integrative") {
    stage_subtitle <- "Integrative cross-experiment analysis (E1 + E2 pooled)"
    stage_models_summary <- sprintf(
      "Models fitted in this stage:\n
All three analyses below are 3-way mixed-effects models with Experiment (E1
sequential vs E2 simultaneous) as a between-subjects factor. Participant ids
were uniquified across experiments via the prefix '<Exp>_' to prevent any
collision between E1 and E2 numeric ids.

1. **Rejection rate (GLMM_rejection):** binomial mixed-effects model on
   reject_binary with predictors Experiment x emotion x offer type (full
   3-way interaction).

2. **Response time, main analysis (LMM_RT_main):** linear mixed-effects model
   on log RT with predictors Experiment x emotion x offer type (full 3-way
   interaction). Reaction not included (collider; Rohrer, 2018).

3. **Response time, unfair-only (LMM_RT_unfair):** linear mixed-effects model
   on log RT restricted to unfair trials, with Experiment x emotion x
   reaction.

Post-hoc decomposition for 3-way models follows the Maxwell-Delaney layered
strategy: when the 3-way interaction is significant, simple effects are
decomposed per Experiment. When the 3-way is not significant, lower-order
2-way interactions are evaluated independently and main effects reported
only for factors NOT participating in any significant 2-way interaction.")
  } else {
    stage_subtitle <- sprintf("Stage %s", stage)
    stage_models_summary <- "Unknown stage."
  }
  
  methods_paragraph <- sprintf(
'# Methods Paragraph (Behavioral Analyses, Stage %s)

%s

Generated: %s

## Statistical Analysis

Behavioral data were analyzed using mixed-effects models in R (%s) with the
lme4 (%s) and lmerTest (%s) packages, with binomial models fitted via glmmTMB
(%s). Categorical predictors used sum-to-zero contrasts (R option contr.sum)
to support valid Type III tests in the presence of interactions (Schad,
Vasishth, Hohenstein, & Kliegl, 2020). Trials were excluded if the
participant did not respond (reaction = 0), if response time fell outside
%d-%d ms, or if the offer was the medium-fairness filler (Offers_Other = 7).
Response time was log-transformed for the linear models to stabilize variance
and better meet the assumption of normally distributed residuals. For each
fitted linear model, residual assumptions were assessed via residual skewness
and excess kurtosis, a homoscedasticity index (the Spearman correlation between
the absolute residual and the fitted value), and Q-Q and residual-vs-fitted
plots (assumptions_<analysis>.md and .pdf in each output directory). At the
single-trial sample sizes used here, formal normality tests are over-powered
and were therefore not used for this purpose.

%s

### Random-effects structure

Random-effects structures were selected following the parsimonious-Bates
protocol (Bates, Kliegl, Vasishth, & Baayen, 2015; Matuschek, Kliegl,
Vasishth, Baayen, & Bates, 2017). Starting from the design-justified maximal
model (random intercepts and slopes for within-subject factors and their
interaction by participant), zero-correlation parameter (ZCP) models were fitted by
representing factor slopes as separate sum-contrast columns, so that the ZCP
terms were genuinely diagonal rather than correlated dummy-level blocks.
All contrast columns belonging to one main or interaction term were grouped as one buildmer
selection block through the documented buildmer terms-list interface.
Unsupported variance-component blocks were removed via likelihood-ratio tests
with elimination alpha = 0.20 using the buildmer package. Correlation
parameters between surviving slopes were tested in a final step.
Random-effects dimensionality was diagnosed via rePCA (Bates et al., 2015).
Because this selection is data-driven and applied to each dataset independently,
the retained structure can differ across experiments; such differences reflect
genuine between-experiment differences in the supported variance components and
are reported as-is. Cross-experiment inference is therefore based on the
Integrative model (the Experiment x condition interaction terms), not on
comparing the significance of separately fitted per-experiment models.

For the Integrative analysis, Experiment was modeled as a between-subjects
factor (each participant belongs to exactly one experiment). Random slopes
for Experiment by participant are unidentifiable by design and were
therefore not included. Participant ids were prefixed by the experiment
label ("E1_", "E2_") to guarantee uniqueness across experiments.

Stimulus identity was counterbalanced across participants via a Latin-square
design and was not modeled as a separate random effect (cf. Westfall, Kenny,
& Judd, 2014).

### Inferential strategy

For linear mixed models, fixed-effect inference used a Type III F-test with
denominator degrees of freedom approximated via a cascading method
preference: Satterthwaite (Kuznetsova, Brockhoff, & Christensen, 2017;
Luke, 2017) was attempted first; on numerical failure, Kenward-Roger
(Kenward & Roger, 1997; via the pbkrtest backend) was attempted; Wald
chi-square (car::Anova) was used only as a final fallback. The method
actually used per analysis is reported in the supplementary REPRODUCIBILITY
log. For the binomial model, Wald chi-square tests were used because
Satterthwaite and Kenward-Roger are not defined for non-Gaussian
likelihoods (the residual variance term they require does not exist in
binomial likelihoods, where Var(y) is determined by the mean structure as
p(1-p)). Binomial models were fitted by maximum likelihood with the Laplace
approximation (glmmTMB; Brooks et al., 2017), and fixed effects were tested with
Wald chi-square tests (Bolker et al., 2009). Because the responses are binary
(Bernoulli, 0/1), observation-level overdispersion is not identifiable -- the
variance p(1-p) is fixed entirely by the mean -- so no scale or dispersion
parameter was estimated.

Post-hoc contrasts were computed using the emmeans package (Lenth, 2024)
with asymptotic standard errors and false-discovery-rate (FDR) correction
within each effect family.

### Effect-size reporting

For Gaussian models, partial eta-squared with 95%% confidence intervals are
reported alongside F-tests (effectsize::eta_squared). For the binomial
model, partial eta-squared is not defined; odds ratios with 95%% CIs are
reported for fixed-effect contrasts, and marginal R-squared (Nakagawa-
Schielzeth, 2013) together with the Tjur (2009) coefficient of discrimination
are reported for overall model fit (the conditional R-squared is reported
additionally when the random-effect variance is extractable). For log-RT
contrasts, percent RT change is reported as (exp(b) - 1) x 100.

### Post-hoc gating

For 2-way analyses (single-experiment stages E1 and E2), simple-effect
decompositions of the emotion x offer_type (or emotion x reaction)
interaction were performed only when the omnibus interaction p < %.2f.
Effects with %.2f <= p < %.2f were computed but reported only in
supplementary materials, never as confirmatory evidence.

For 3-way analyses (Integrative stage), decomposition was layered:
(a) if the 3-way Experiment x emotion x within-factor interaction was
significant (p < %.2f), simple effects were decomposed per Experiment;
(b) if 0.05 <= 3-way p < 0.10, the same decomposition was performed but
written to Supplementary; (c) if the 3-way was not significant, each 2-way
interaction was evaluated independently and main effects reported only for
factors not participating in any significant 2-way interaction.

## Sample

%d trials from %d unique participants entered the main analyses in this stage;
the unfair-only stratum included %d trials.

',
    stage,
    stage_subtitle,
    format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
    paste(R.version$major, R.version$minor, sep = "."),
    as.character(packageVersion("lme4")),
    as.character(packageVersion("lmerTest")),
    as.character(packageVersion("glmmTMB")),
    rt_lower_ms, rt_upper_ms,
    stage_models_summary,
    confirmatory_alpha, confirmatory_alpha, marginal_threshold,
    confirmatory_alpha,
    nrow(df_clean),
    dplyr::n_distinct(df_clean$participant_id_internal),
    nrow(df_unfair)
  )
  
  writeLines(methods_paragraph,
             con = file.path(out_tables,
                             sprintf("Methods_paragraph_%s.md", stage)))
  cat(sprintf("[Methods] Methods_paragraph_%s.md written.\n", stage))
  
  # ---- Accumulate models for cross-stage view ----
  all_stage_models[[stage]] <- behavior_models
  
  cat(sprintf("\n[%s pipeline complete] Fitted %d/%d analyses in stage %s.\n",
              stage, length(behavior_models), total_analyses, stage))
}

cat(sprintf("\n\n========================================\n   ALL STAGES COMPLETE.\n   Total elapsed: %s\n   Output root: %s\n========================================\n",
            format_elapsed(pipeline_t0), out_root_base))
```

``` {r trait-maineffect-screen}
# ==============================================================================
# 7b. Exploratory individual-differences (trait) main-effect screen  [E1, E2]
# ==============================================================================
# PURPOSE. A screen of whether stable between-subjects characteristics shift
# OVERALL task behaviour. For each experiment SEPARATELY (E1, E2; NOT the pooled
# Integrative stage), and for each of the two primary behavioural outcomes
# (rejection: reject_binary, GLMM binomial; speed: logRT, LMM Gaussian), each
# candidate variable is added as a single grand-standardized (z) MAIN-EFFECT
# covariate on top of the already-selected design model:
#
#   <outcome> ~ (emotion + offer_type)^2 + <var>_z + <design random structure>
#
# The design random structure is inherited from the corresponding primary model
# (Section 7) so the trait models within an outcome share one data-supported
# random structure and are mutually comparable (mirrors the EEG nuisance-
# covariate control in Sta_EEG_OfferPhase_RefAlday.Rmd).
#
# VARIABLES (10), in three families:
#   SVO      : SVO_angle  -- Social Value Orientation (the one a-priori variable).
#   PID5BF+  : Negative_Affectivity, Detachment, Antagonism, Disinhibition,
#              Anankastia, Psychoticism  -- the 6 ICD-11-aligned PID5BF+ domains.
#   Ratings  : Rating_1, Rating_2, Rating_3  -- post-task cover-story belief
#              checks (manipulation checks; z-scored here only for comparability).
#
# INTERPRETATION & LIMITS (read before using any result):
#   * MAIN EFFECT ONLY, by request. No trait x design interaction is fitted. A
#     purely between-subjects covariate is, in expectation, orthogonal to the
#     within-subject design contrasts (emotion, offer_type, their interaction),
#     so it can only absorb between-subjects intercept variance. A significant
#     <var>_z thus means individuals higher on that variable reject more/less
#     (GLMM) or are slower/faster (LMM) OVERALL -- NOT that the trait moderates
#     the emotion or fairness effects.
#   * EXPLORATORY at n ~= 30 subjects/experiment: between-subjects effects are
#     low-powered. Estimates are reported with 95% CIs and BH-FDR within family;
#     neither significant nor null results should be over-interpreted. SVO_angle
#     is a-priori; PID5BF+ and the ratings are screened, not hypothesis-tested.
# ==============================================================================

# ---- Configuration ------------------------------------------------------------
trait_screen_stages <- getOption("ug.trait_stages", c("E1", "E2"))  # per-experiment only

trait_families <- list(
  SVO     = c("SVO_angle"),
  PID5BF  = c("Negative_Affectivity", "Detachment", "Antagonism",
              "Disinhibition", "Anankastia", "Psychoticism"),
  Ratings = c("Rating_1", "Rating_2", "Rating_3")
)
trait_screen_vars <- unlist(trait_families, use.names = FALSE)
trait_var_family  <- setNames(rep(names(trait_families), lengths(trait_families)),
                              trait_screen_vars)
family_of <- function(v) unname(trait_var_family[[v]])

# The two primary single-experiment outcomes (reuse their design + family).
trait_outcomes <- list(
  GLMM_Rejection = list(main_name = "GLMM_rejection", outcome = "reject_binary",
                        family = "binomial", scale = "logit", effect_type = "OR"),
  LMM_RT_main    = list(main_name = "LMM_RT_main",    outcome = "logRT",
                        family = "gaussian", scale = "logRT", effect_type = "pctRT")
)
trait_design_fixed   <- "(emotion + offer_type)^2"
trait_design_include <- c("emotion", "offer_type", "emotion:offer_type")
trait_random_vars    <- c("emotion", "offer_type")
trait_timeout_sec    <- 1800

# ---- Helpers ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Type III ANOVA cascade (compact mirror of run_behavior_analysis): Wald chi2 for
# GLMM; Satterthwaite -> Kenward-Roger -> Wald for LMM. Returns list(table, method).
trait_anova_cascade <- function(model, family) {
  if (family == "binomial") {
    return(list(table = car::Anova(model, type = 3, test.statistic = "Chisq"),
                method = "Wald_chi_square_GLMM"))
  }
  m <- model
  if (inherits(m, "merMod") && !inherits(m, "lmerModLmerTest")) {
    m2 <- tryCatch(lmerTest::as_lmerModLmerTest(m), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(m2)) m <- m2
  }
  for (ddf in c("Satterthwaite", "Kenward-Roger")) {
    res <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(anova(m, type = 3, ddf = ddf)),
                    error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(res) && any(grepl("^Pr", colnames(res))))
      return(list(table = res, method = paste0(gsub("-", "_", ddf), "_F")))
  }
  list(table = car::Anova(m, type = 3, test.statistic = "Chisq"),
       method = "Wald_chi_square")
}

# Random-structure string from a fitted base model (mirror EEG Track C).
trait_re_string <- function(model, group = "participant_id_internal") {
  re <- tryCatch(lme4::findbars(stats::formula(model)), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(re) || length(re) == 0)
    return(sprintf("(1 | %s)", group))
  paste0("(", vapply(re, function(b) paste(deparse(b), collapse = " "), character(1)),
         ")", collapse = " + ")
}

# Fit the exact trait formula under the same mandatory numerical gate as the
# primary models. No alternative random structure is substituted here.
fit_trait_model_validated <- function(formula, data, family) {
  if (family == "binomial") {
    candidates <- list(
      BFGS = fit_glmm_candidate(
        formula, data, custom_control_glmmTMB, "BFGS"
      ),
      nlminb = fit_glmm_candidate(
        formula, data, custom_control_glmmTMB_nlminb, "nlminb"
      )
    )
    valid <- Filter(function(x) {
      !is.null(x) && isTRUE(attr(x, "final_validation")$valid)
    }, candidates)
    if (length(valid) == 0) {
      stop("Trait GLMM failed the acceptance gate under both BFGS and nlminb.")
    }
    aics <- vapply(valid, AIC, numeric(1))
    return(valid[[which.min(aics)]])
  }

  model <- lmerTest::lmer(
    formula, data = data, REML = TRUE,
    control = custom_control_lmer_final
  )
  diagnostics <- mixed_model_diagnostics(
    model, require_derivatives = TRUE
  )
  attr(model, "final_validation") <- diagnostics
  attr(model, "final_refit_optimizer") <- "bobyqa"
  if (!isTRUE(diagnostics$valid)) {
    stop("Trait LMM failed the acceptance gate: ",
         format_model_diagnostics(diagnostics))
  }
  model
}

write_trait_failure <- function(comp_dir, outcome, variable, stage,
                                formula, reason) {
  if (!dir.exists(comp_dir)) dir.create(comp_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  formula_text <- if (is.null(formula)) "Not constructed" else
    paste(deparse(formula), collapse = " ")
  writeLines(c(
    sprintf("# Trait main-effect screen FAILED: %s, %s [%s]",
            outcome, variable, stage),
    sprintf("Generated: %s", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")),
    "",
    sprintf("Model: %s", formula_text),
    "",
    "No estimate is reported for this run because the model did not pass",
    "the required fitting and numerical-acceptance checks.",
    "",
    sprintf("Reason: %s", reason)
  ), file.path(comp_dir, "trait_maineffect.md"))
}

write_empty_trait_summary <- function(out_dir, outcome, stage) {
  empty_summary <- data.frame(
    Family = character(), Variable = character(), Outcome = character(),
    N_subjects = integer(), N_trials = integer(), Estimate = numeric(),
    SE = numeric(), Statistic = numeric(), p_raw = numeric(),
    Effect_type = character(), Effect = numeric(),
    Effect_CI_low = numeric(), Effect_CI_high = numeric(),
    p_fdr = numeric(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  utils::write.csv(
    empty_summary,
    file.path(out_dir, sprintf("TRAIT_SUMMARY_%s_%s.csv", outcome, stage)),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  writeLines(c(
    sprintf("# Trait main-effect screen summary -- %s, %s", outcome, stage),
    sprintf("Generated: %s", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")),
    "",
    "No model passed the required fitting and numerical-acceptance checks",
    "in this run. See the per-variable files for failure reasons."
  ), file.path(out_dir, sprintf("TRAIT_SUMMARY_%s_%s.md", outcome, stage)))
}

# Extract the focal trait coefficient row from a fitted model.
trait_coef_row <- function(model, vz) {
  pp <- tryCatch(as.data.frame(parameters::parameters(model, effects = "fixed",
                                                      ci = 0.95)),
                 error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(pp)) return(NULL)
  row <- pp[pp$Parameter == vz, , drop = FALSE]
  if ("Component" %in% names(pp) && nrow(row) > 1)
    row <- row[row$Component %in% c("conditional", "cond"), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(row) == 0) return(NULL)
  row <- row[1, ]
  stat_col <- intersect(c("z", "t", "Statistic", "Chi2"), names(row))
  stat <- if (length(stat_col)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(row[[stat_col[1]]])) else NA_real_
  list(est = row$Coefficient, se = row$SE,
       ci_low = row$CI_low, ci_high = row$CI_high,
       stat = stat, p = row$p)
}

# ---- Screen loop --------------------------------------------------------------
trait_screen_summaries <- list()

for (stage in if (isTRUE(getOption("ug.run_trait_screen", TRUE))) trait_screen_stages else character()) {
  progress_log(sprintf("\n%s\n>>> TRAIT MAIN-EFFECT SCREEN: %s\n%s",
                       strrep("=", 70), stage, strrep("=", 70)))

  # Data (reload; cheap and keeps this section self-contained).
  path_trials <- here("data", paste0("02_Pipeline_Output_", stage),
                      "Method_Regression", "Stimulus_Locked", "trials.csv")
  if (!file.exists(path_trials)) {
    progress_log(sprintf("[Trait screen | %s] trials.csv missing; skipping stage.", stage))
    next
  }
  df_clean <- load_single_experiment(path_trials, stage)

  # Covariate table.
  cov_path <- here("data", paste0("02_Pipeline_Output_", stage), "Covariates",
                   sprintf("SVO_PID5BF_PostRating_%s.xlsx", stage))
  if (!file.exists(cov_path)) {
    progress_log(sprintf("[Trait screen | %s] covariate file missing (%s); skipping stage.",
                         stage, basename(cov_path)))
    next
  }
  cov <- readxl::read_excel(cov_path)
  cov$participant_id_internal <- standardize_id_within_exp(cov[[1]])
  cov <- cov[!duplicated(cov$participant_id_internal), , drop = FALSE]   # one row/subject

  # Restrict to the analysis sample, then z-score each variable over THOSE
  # subjects (subject-level standardization: a trait is constant within subject,
  # so it must be standardized across subjects, never across trials).
  analysis_subj <- unique(df_clean$participant_id_internal)
  cov <- cov[cov$participant_id_internal %in% analysis_subj, , drop = FALSE]
  n_cov_subj <- nrow(cov)
  avail_vars <- intersect(trait_screen_vars, names(cov))
  for (v in avail_vars) {
    x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(cov[[v]]))
    s <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    cov[[paste0(v, "_z")]] <- if (is.na(s) || s == 0) NA_real_
                              else (x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / s
  }
  z_cols <- paste0(avail_vars, "_z")
  df_merged <- dplyr::left_join(
    df_clean,
    cov[, c("participant_id_internal", z_cols), drop = FALSE],
    by = "participant_id_internal"
  )

  # Primary models create explicit sum-contrast random-slope columns inside
  # fit_stage1_bates(). Trait refits reuse those formulas outside that function,
  # so the same columns must also exist in the outer analysis data.
  trait_random_design <- add_random_contrast_columns(
    df_merged, random_vars = trait_random_vars,
    group_name = "participant_id_internal"
  )
  df_merged <- trait_random_design$data

  out_stage <- file.path(out_root_base, sprintf("%s_TwoStage_Bates", stage),
                         "Trait_MainEffects")
  if (!dir.exists(out_stage)) dir.create(out_stage, recursive = TRUE)

  trait_outcome_status <- list()

  for (oc_key in names(trait_outcomes)) {
    oc       <- trait_outcomes[[oc_key]]
    response <- oc$outcome
    out_oc   <- file.path(out_stage, oc_key)
    if (!dir.exists(out_oc)) dir.create(out_oc, recursive = TRUE)

    progress_log(sprintf("[Trait screen | %s | %s] design model + %d trait refits",
                         stage, oc_key, length(avail_vars)))

    # Base design model: reuse the primary Section-7 fit when available, else fit.
    base_model <- NULL
    if (exists("all_stage_models") && !is.null(all_stage_models[[stage]]) &&
        !is.null(all_stage_models[[stage]][[oc$main_name]])) {
      base_model <- all_stage_models[[stage]][[oc$main_name]]
      progress_log("  Reusing primary design model from Section 7.", indent = 1)
    }
    if (is.null(base_model) && !is.null(getOption("ug.trait_model_root"))) {
      model_path <- file.path(getOption("ug.trait_model_root"), "Behavior",
                              paste0(stage, "_TwoStage_Bates"), oc$main_name,
                              paste0("final_model_", oc$main_name, ".rds"))
      if (!file.exists(model_path)) stop("Missing revised primary model: ", model_path)
      base_model <- readRDS(model_path)
      progress_log(paste("Reusing verified revised primary model:", model_path), indent = 1)
    }
    if (is.null(base_model)) {
      base_model <- tryCatch(
        fit_stage1_bates(df_merged, response, trait_design_fixed,
                         trait_design_include, oc$family,
                         random_max_vars = trait_random_vars,
                         group_name = "participant_id_internal",
                         timeout_sec = trait_timeout_sec),
        error = function(e) {
          progress_log(sprintf("  base fit failed: %s", conditionMessage(e)), indent = 1)
          NULL
        })
    }
    if (is.null(base_model)) {
      progress_log(sprintf("[Trait screen | %s | %s] no base model; skipping outcome.",
                           stage, oc_key))
      trait_outcome_status[[oc_key]] <- c(
        passed = 0L, attempted = length(avail_vars)
      )
      for (v in avail_vars) {
        comp_dir <- file.path(out_oc, paste0("Trait_", v))
        write_trait_failure(
          comp_dir, oc_key, v, stage, NULL,
          "The primary design model did not pass its acceptance gate."
        )
      }
      write_empty_trait_summary(out_oc, oc_key, stage)
      next
    }
    re_string <- trait_re_string(base_model)

    rows <- list()
    for (v in avail_vars) {
      vz <- paste0(v, "_z")
      comp_dir <- file.path(out_oc, paste0("Trait_", v))
      if (!dir.exists(comp_dir)) dir.create(comp_dir, recursive = TRUE)
      if (!vz %in% names(df_merged) || all(is.na(df_merged[[vz]]))) {
        progress_log(sprintf("  [%s] no usable values; skipped.", v), indent = 1)
        write_trait_failure(
          comp_dir, oc_key, v, stage, NULL,
          "No usable values were available after merging the covariate table."
        )
        next
      }
      sub    <- df_merged[!is.na(df_merged[[vz]]), , drop = FALSE]
      n_used <- nrow(sub)
      n_drop <- nrow(df_merged) - n_used
      n_subj <- dplyr::n_distinct(sub$participant_id_internal)
      f_v <- stats::as.formula(sprintf("%s ~ %s + %s + %s",
                                       response, trait_design_fixed, vz, re_string))
      fit_error <- NA_character_
      fit <- tryCatch(
        fit_trait_model_validated(f_v, sub, oc$family),
        error = function(e) {
          fit_error <<- conditionMessage(e)
          progress_log(sprintf("  [%s] fit failed: %s", v, fit_error), indent = 1)
          NULL
        }
      )
      if (is.null(fit)) {
        write_trait_failure(comp_dir, oc_key, v, stage, f_v, fit_error)
        next
      }
      fit_diag <- attr(fit, "final_validation") %||%
        mixed_model_diagnostics(fit, require_derivatives = TRUE)

      ca        <- trait_anova_cascade(fit, oc$family)
      anova_apa <- tryCatch(format_anova_apa(ca$table, fit), error = function(e) NULL)
      coefs     <- tryCatch(format_coefs(fit), error = function(e) NULL)
      cr        <- trait_coef_row(fit, vz)
      if (is.null(cr)) {
        progress_log(sprintf("  [%s] trait coefficient not recovered; skipped.", v), indent = 1)
        write_trait_failure(
          comp_dir, oc_key, v, stage, f_v,
          "The fitted model passed the numerical gate, but the focal trait coefficient could not be recovered."
        )
        next
      }

      # Effect on the report scale.
      if (oc$effect_type == "OR") {
        eff <- exp(cr$est); eff_l <- exp(cr$ci_low); eff_h <- exp(cr$ci_high)
        eff_str <- sprintf("OR = %.3f [%.3f, %.3f] per +1 SD", eff, eff_l, eff_h)
      } else {
        eff   <- (exp(cr$est) - 1) * 100
        eff_l <- (exp(cr$ci_low) - 1) * 100
        eff_h <- (exp(cr$ci_high) - 1) * 100
        eff_str <- sprintf("%+.2f%% RT [%+.2f%%, %+.2f%%] per +1 SD", eff, eff_l, eff_h)
      }
      p_str <- if (is.na(cr$p)) "p = NA" else
        paste("p", format_p_apa(cr$p, include_equals = TRUE))
      n_msg <- if (n_drop == 0)
        sprintf("N: %d trials (%d subjects); no rows dropped for missing %s.",
                n_used, n_subj, v)
      else
        sprintf("N: %d trials (%d subjects) after dropping %d trials with missing %s.",
                n_used, n_subj, n_drop, v)

      # ---- Per-variable markdown (mirror EEG covariate_control.md) ----
      writeLines(c(
        sprintf("# Trait main-effect screen (%s): %s  [%s]", oc_key, v, stage),
        sprintf("Generated: %s", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")),
        "",
        sprintf("Family: %s", family_of(v)),
        sprintf("Model: %s", paste(deparse(f_v), collapse = " ")),
        sprintf("Model acceptance: %s", format_model_diagnostics(fit_diag)),
        sprintf("Optimizer: %s",
                attr(fit, "final_refit_optimizer") %||% "not recorded"),
        "",
        "EXPLORATORY, per-experiment, MAIN-EFFECT-ONLY screen. The variable is a",
        "subject-level (between-subjects) covariate entered as a single grand-",
        "standardized (z) main effect; no trait x design interaction is fitted.",
        "A between-subjects covariate is (in expectation) orthogonal to the",
        "within-subject design contrasts, so a significant term reflects an",
        "OVERALL shift (in rejection / in RT) with the variable, NOT moderation",
        "of the emotion or fairness effects. Interpret cautiously at n ~= 30.",
        "",
        n_msg,
        "",
        "## Focal trait main effect",
        sprintf("- %s (z): %s", v, eff_str),
        sprintf("- b = %.4f (model scale: %s), SE = %.4f, stat = %.3f, %s",
                cr$est, oc$scale, cr$se, cr$stat, p_str),
        "",
        "## Type III ANOVA (design effects with the trait covariate)",
        if (!is.null(anova_apa))
          knitr::kable(anova_apa, format = "markdown", row.names = FALSE)
        else "ANOVA failed.",
        "",
        "## Fixed-effect coefficients (incl. trait covariate)",
        if (!is.null(coefs))
          knitr::kable(coefs, format = "markdown", row.names = FALSE)
        else "Coefficient extraction failed."
      ), file.path(comp_dir, "trait_maineffect.md"))

      rows[[v]] <- data.frame(
        Family         = family_of(v),
        Variable       = v,
        Outcome        = oc_key,
        N_subjects     = n_subj,
        N_trials       = n_used,
        Estimate       = cr$est,
        SE             = cr$se,
        Statistic      = cr$stat,
        p_raw          = cr$p,
        Effect_type    = oc$effect_type,
        Effect         = eff,
        Effect_CI_low  = eff_l,
        Effect_CI_high = eff_h,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      progress_log(sprintf("  [%s] %s, %s", v, eff_str, p_str), indent = 1)
    }

    trait_outcome_status[[oc_key]] <- c(
      passed = length(rows), attempted = length(avail_vars)
    )

    if (length(rows) == 0) {
      progress_log(sprintf("[Trait screen | %s | %s] no models fitted.", stage, oc_key))
      write_empty_trait_summary(out_oc, oc_key, stage)
      next
    }

    summ <- do.call(rbind, rows)
    # BH-FDR within each family (per outcome). SVO has 1 member -> fdr == raw.
    summ$p_fdr <- NA_real_
    for (fam in unique(summ$Family)) {
      idx <- summ$Family == fam
      summ$p_fdr[idx] <- p.adjust(summ$p_raw[idx], method = "BH")
    }
    fam_order <- c("SVO", "PID5BF", "Ratings")
    summ <- summ[order(match(summ$Family, fam_order), summ$p_raw), ]

    # CSV (full precision).
    utils::write.csv(summ,
                     file.path(out_oc, sprintf("TRAIT_SUMMARY_%s_%s.csv", oc_key, stage)),
                     row.names = FALSE)

    # Markdown (formatted).
    eff_hdr <- if (oc$effect_type == "OR") "OR [95% CI] /SD" else "%RT change [95% CI] /SD"
    summ_md <- data.frame(
      Family   = summ$Family,
      Variable = summ$Variable,
      N        = summ$N_subjects,
      Effect   = if (oc$effect_type == "OR")
                   sprintf("%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]", summ$Effect, summ$Effect_CI_low, summ$Effect_CI_high)
                 else
                   sprintf("%+.2f [%+.2f, %+.2f]", summ$Effect, summ$Effect_CI_low, summ$Effect_CI_high),
      b        = sprintf("%.4f", summ$Estimate),
      stat     = sprintf("%.3f", summ$Statistic),
      p_raw    = format_p_apa(summ$p_raw),
      p_FDR    = format_p_apa(summ$p_fdr),
      check.names = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    names(summ_md)[names(summ_md) == "Effect"] <- eff_hdr
    writeLines(c(
      sprintf("# Trait main-effect screen summary -- %s, %s", oc_key, stage),
      sprintf("Generated: %s", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")),
      "",
      sprintf("Outcome: %s (%s). Each row adds one z-scored variable as a main",
              response, oc$family),
      "effect to the primary design model (emotion x offer_type) with the",
      "design-selected random structure. Effects are per +1 SD of the variable.",
      "p_FDR = Benjamini-Hochberg within family (SVO / PID5BF+ / Ratings).",
      "EXPLORATORY; main-effect only; n ~= 30. See per-variable folders for full",
      "ANOVA and coefficient tables.",
      "",
      knitr::kable(summ_md, format = "markdown", row.names = FALSE)
    ), file.path(out_oc, sprintf("TRAIT_SUMMARY_%s_%s.md", oc_key, stage)))

    trait_screen_summaries[[stage]][[oc_key]] <- summ
    progress_log(sprintf("[Trait screen | %s | %s] summary written (%d variables).",
                         stage, oc_key, nrow(summ)))
  }

  # ---- Stage reproducibility log ----
  sink(file.path(out_stage, "TRAIT_MAINEFFECT_REPRODUCIBILITY.txt"))
  cat("# Trait main-effect screen -- reproducibility log\n")
  cat("# Stage:", stage, "\n")
  cat("# Generated:", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "\n\n")
  cat("## Design\n")
  cat("Per-experiment, exploratory, MAIN-EFFECT-ONLY screen.\n")
  cat("Outcomes:", paste(names(trait_outcomes), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("Fixed design:", trait_design_fixed, "+ <var>_z\n")
  cat("Random structure: inherited from the primary Section-7 design model per outcome.\n")
  cat("Variables (z-scored over the analysis sample,", n_cov_subj, "subjects):\n")
  for (fam in names(trait_families))
    cat(sprintf("  %-8s: %s\n", fam, paste(trait_families[[fam]], collapse = ", ")))
  cat("\n## Multiplicity\n")
  cat("Benjamini-Hochberg FDR within each family, separately per outcome.\n\n")
  cat("## Model acceptance\n")
  cat("Only exact-formula models passing optimizer, singularity, Hessian,\n")
  cat("finite-SE, and finite-likelihood checks were written as results.\n")
  for (oc_key in names(trait_outcome_status)) {
    status <- trait_outcome_status[[oc_key]]
    cat(sprintf("  %s: %d / %d models passed.\n",
                oc_key, status[["passed"]], status[["attempted"]]))
  }
  cat("\n")
  cat("## Software versions\n")
  cat("R:         ", R.version.string, "\n")
  cat("lme4:      ", as.character(packageVersion("lme4")), "\n")
  cat("lmerTest:  ", as.character(packageVersion("lmerTest")), "\n")
  cat("glmmTMB:   ", as.character(packageVersion("glmmTMB")), "\n")
  cat("parameters:", as.character(packageVersion("parameters")), "\n")
  sink()
  progress_log(sprintf("[Trait screen | %s] reproducibility log written -> %s",
                       stage, out_stage))
}

cat("\n>>> Trait main-effect screen complete.\n")
```
